method: Repeated, sequential CPU-only Qwen benchmark. No microphone, actions or background inference.
note: Same prompts and seed, 3 workload types, 2/3/4 threads, cold after explicit unload and warm second request. Disk cache/thermal/order effects remain. CPU/RSS include Ollama server and all descendants; RSS may double-count shared pages. Deadline 45 s for measurement versus 12 s runtime. Not end-to-end voice latency.
